verdict.rationale: Moosend is an email marketing SaaS with AI-powered content suggestions, so acting as an MCP client is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions MCP or plugging in external tool servers. The generic 'connect all your apps' integration claim is an adjacent feature, not MCP client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
